sentences.l2: 高校の文化祭で、私たちのバンドはオリジナルの曲を発表することにした。
sentences.l1: At the high school cultural festival, our band decided to present an original song.

sentences.l2: 有名な曲を演奏すれば盛り上がりやすいが、敢えて自分たちの言葉で歌いたかったのだ。
sentences.l1: Playing a famous song would easily get the crowd excited, but we dared to want to sing in our own words.

sentences.l2: 歌詞はメンバー全員で考え、一人一人の高校生活の思い出を詰め込んだ。
sentences.l1: All the members thought up the lyrics together, and we packed them with each person's memories of high school life.

sentences.l2: 当日、ステージに立つと手が震えたが、最後まで心を込めて演奏した。
sentences.l1: On the day, my hands shook when I stood on the stage, but I performed with all my heart until the end.

sentences.l2: 演奏の後、沢山の拍手をもらい、私たちにとって忘れられない経験になった。
sentences.l1: After the performance, we received a lot of applause, and it became an unforgettable experience for us.
